newsitem.title: UK: LME copper, aluminium ease further in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper, aluminium ease further in late trading.

text.p: Copper and aluminium prices slid lower in late trading on Tuesday following weak closes on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
Three months copper was indicated at $2,325/$2,330 per tonne at 1900 GMT, compared to the afternoon kerb close of $2,333.
The $2,330 level was the red metal's first support, followed by $2,312 and $2,300, traders said.
Meanwhile aluminium extended the day's decline to $1,631/$1,633, versus $1,642 at the kerb close.
Aluminium prices had pushed lower on fund and speculative liquidation throughout the day, despite a hefty stocks fall of 6,100 tonnes.
The other LME metals were also easier.
